title: Large Language Models as Superpositions of Cultural Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Values Survey Module (VSM) questionnaire based on Hofstede's cultural dimensions to measure how different contexts and perspective-inducing prompts (e.g., text formats, simulated conversations) shift the model's expressed cultural values.
Administering the Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ) based on Schwartz's theory to evaluate how seemingly unrelated contextual changes alter the personal values expressed by the model.
Administering the Big Five personality traits questionnaire (IPIP) to assess the impact of context variations and prompt framing on the model's expressed personality traits.
